name: Martos (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of the city of Martos (quartered, a cross of Calatrava, a tower, a bar and a dragon).
history: The flag of Martos is described as white and rectangular with a proportion between the width and the length of 2 to 3, with the official arms of the city at the centre; the symbolism of the flag is unknown, but the official description is based on the flag traditionally and historically used by the town council. The arms were regulated in 2015.
